mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, reference_price, stage1_pct, stage2_pct, stage1_alerted_at, stage2_alerted_at, active, created_at FROM reentry_watch WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reentry_watch (symbol, reference_price, stage1_pct, stage2_pct, active, created_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{referencePrice}, #{stage1Pct}, #{stage2Pct}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE reentry_watch SET stage1_alerted_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reentry_watch SET stage2_alerted_at = #{at}, active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
